Algebraic analysis locates its physical-sheet pole and the two square-root branchpoints. The critical pole-branch collision at p=4/5 supplies the coefficient 2/(9 sqrt(2 pi)); strict pole and branch regimes have stated explicit amplitudes. 210 exact rational finite tests independently compare reflection enumerations with coefficient extraction, and four asymptotic checks pass. The proof, not finite checks, supports all n and all real p.
